atts.text: Every altitude layer changes the atmosphere. Dense fog, moss saturation, and forest acoustics evolve as the sanctuary ascends through the mountains.
Orchids, mosses, and canopy-rooted species grow suspended in mist-heavy atmospheric corridors.

atts.title: Floating ecosystems between fog and light.
atts.heading: h2

atts.text: Underground fungal communication systems extending beneath the mountain floor.
Deep canopy moisture creates a permanent veil between the forest floor and the upper alpine ridge.
